policy: Use every measured repetition; no sample is discarded. Candidate A is paired to frozen A+B; candidate B to frozen B+C; pooled NUMA is also compared with all 15 frozen repetitions. Percent delta is candidate/baseline-1, so negative wall_s means faster. pack_s percentage is suppressed when baseline pack is below 0.1 ms because the frozen direct path performs its material packing inside split_s; report absolute stage deltas instead. pack_s includes replica allocation+copy; replicate_b_s isolates copy only and is not additive with pack_s.
rss_note: max_rss_kib is process-wide ru_maxrss observed after each call (peak, not per-call RSS delta); fault and context-switch columns are per-call getrusage differences.
